description: Per-feature bidirectional cross-modal count-likelihood scorer avoiding global bottleneck compression. Inputs: candidate depth-normalised cis_peaks with TSS-distance/promoter encodings, depth-residualised trans lsi, promoter gene_activity skip, raw query RNA UMI counts with total UMI exposure L_q, and candidate binarised cis-peaks with ATAC depth D_c. Forward head uses multi-head cis-attention modulated by trans-LSI to output simplex-normalised gene rates pi_cg (summing to 1, invariant to candidate depth) and per-gene NB dispersions r_g, scoring exact per-gene NB log-likelihoods of query RNA counts centered against a fixed inner_train RNA bank. Reverse head maps dropout-aware RNA inputs via a residual MLP and rank-64 bottleneck to cis-peak log-odds shifts over frozen inner_train marginal depth baselines logit P0(y_cp>0|D_c), computing exact depth-deconfounded Bernoulli log-likelihood ratios. Outputs: per-(query, candidate) PMI matrix combining forward NB scores (weighted by inner_val total and beyond-k20-cluster deviance explained) and reverse Bernoulli LLRs using inner_val-selected hyperparameters, scoring each query independently.

Twin chromosomal locus-token transformers for cross-modal single-cell retrieval. Inputs: 64 contiguous syntenic genomic blocks per cell containing block-wise normalized RNA counts (for queries) or promoter activity, TSS-distance-weighted distal enhancer activity, and TF-IDF cis_peaks (for ATAC candidates), plus standardized log cell depth. Architecture: block-sparse linear stems with depth-conditioned residual subtraction map each locus to d_model=64 tokens; 3-layer 4-head self-attention transformers model trans-chromosomal co-regulation and project each locus to L2-normalized d_proj=24 vectors orthogonalized against the inner-train depth direction, alongside coverage-based locus precision gates normalized per cell. Outputs: 64 precision-scaled locus vectors per cell; independent query-candidate similarity equals the gated multi-locus inner product minus a per-candidate Training-Anchor CSLS hubness offset computed strictly against frozen inner-train RNA embeddings. Training: symmetric InfoNCE with inverse-density cell weights, unsupervised same-cluster and depth-matched hard negatives, depth-decorrelation penalty, and KL/cosine self-distillation from an EMA teacher receiving inner-train knn_pool(12) profiles to a student receiving raw and binomially thinned (p=0.5) single-cell counts.

Dual-modality hierarchical mixture-of-specialists retrieval network. Inputs: per-cell RNA log1p/Pearson-residual features + log RNA depth, and ATAC 128-dim full-atlas LSI + 60k sparse TF-IDF + promoter gene_activity + log ATAC depth. Computes: (1) modality-specific 512-dim residual MLP trunks; (2) soft routers outputting 32 unsupervised regime probabilities q(k|RNA) and p(k|ATAC); (3) 96-dim L2-normalized macro embeddings; and (4) 32 regime-centered specialist 32-dim L2-normalized embeddings parameterized as a shared residual projection plus empirical-Bayes-shrunk (n_k/(n_k+25)) rank-16 LoRA adapters, with differentiable batchwise Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization removing linear correlation with log depth and a depth-driven scalar temperature gate. Outputs: independent pairwise similarity scores combining log Bayes-factor regime compatibility log(sum_k q_k*p_k/pi_k), macro cosine similarity, and joint-responsibility-weighted specialist residual cosine similarity. Training: AdamW on paired inner-train cells minimizing inverse-frequency-weighted router KL/CE, macro InfoNCE, within-regime responsibility-weighted InfoNCE, specialist Barlow-Twins redundancy loss, depth HSIC/covariance penalty, and an auxiliary head predicting inner-train knn_pool(15) targets discarded at inference.
